defect.evidence_quote: Good law; the commercial-premises companion to Camara. Later cases recognized the pervasively-regulated-industry exception (Barlow's, Donovan v. Dewey, Biswell, Burger) but did not disturb See's general warrant rule.
defect.problem: The See entry states the commercial-premises administrative-entry rule without the disclosed later limitation for pervasively regulated industries.
defect.proposed_fix: Revise to: Commercial premises generally have Fourth Amendment protection against warrantless administrative entry, subject to later pervasively regulated industry exceptions; no curtilage does not mean no privacy for a business interior.
